main.description: GFN-1 governance.attestation.v1 -- declares governance posture and enables inter-node trust decisions. Field names are snake_case to match the GFN-1 spec exactly (see RFC-0009). Supersedes the legacy attestation shape (entityDid/capabilitySetId/...) and the standalone com.aegisfederation.governance.capability record -- capability/control declarations are now expressed via controls_implemented and compliance_profiles below rather than a separate record type, since GFN-1 does not register a capability-declaration event type.

signature.description: Signature of the canonicalized envelope, excluding this field

attesting_did.description: DID of the system being attested

auditor_did.description: Third-party auditor or internal assurance identity

controls_implemented.description: Control IDs -- carries forward the capability/control-declaration concept that the retired com.aegisfederation.governance.capability record used to represent as its own record type
